snippet.title: Nyancrement - Short Trailer | From 1 Coin to Millions per Cat Punch
snippet.description:
A cat has wandered into a strange world.
To make it home again, it must collect coins—one cat punch at a time.

At first, each punch earns just 1 coin.
Strengthen your relics, and every punch grows more powerful.

Nyancrement is an incremental game coming to Steam.

Demo in development.

#Nyancrement #IndieGame #IncrementalGame
